tasks.title: Implement one typed feature-effect algebra
tasks.goal: Represent optional dependencies and forwarding without a second choices grammar.
steps: Define stable dependency declaration IDs and local feature references under the permanent PROP-003 contract.
Implement effects for dependency activation, strong/weak target-feature requests, exported subskills and declared config values.
Keep source/version/link/visibility metadata once on dependency declarations; option aliases remain package-local.
positive_cases: One effect set activates an optional dependency and forwards requested features.
negative_cases: Undeclared target IDs, malformed qualified refs and weak-only activation without its dependency refuse or stay dormant as defined.

tasks.title: Add constrained groups and consumer resolution domains
tasks.goal: Make semantic choices explicit while retaining environment and target roles.
steps: Consume accepted M-14 resolution-domain/target/dependency-role carriers instead of inventing a global package instance.
Define four cardinalities, positive same-package acyclic guards, explicit defaults and consumer requested selections.
Distinguish omission, explicit empty selection, dormant branch intent and exact shared-instance conflict; keep backend-native version identities outside Vibe SemVer conversion.
positive_cases: Separate environments may select different configurations; same shared instance combines additive requests.
negative_cases: Conflicting exact selections name both consumers; unsupported cross-package/expression guards refuse.
All-features cannot select constrained members implicitly.

tasks.title: Implement syntax-preserving feature migration
tasks.goal: Deliver deterministic old-to-new authored conversion using M-13 migration primitives.
steps: Recognize the exact old grammar and map unambiguous dependencies/features/groups to new typed declarations.
Preserve comments, user choices and unrelated values; report ambiguous slash names/options as NeedsInput before writes.
Add dry-run diff, saved-state CAS apply and idempotent replay through the existing migration engine.
positive_cases: An unambiguous commented manifest migrates with unchanged selected meaning.
negative_cases: Ambiguous references, unknown source epoch and concurrent edits do not produce partial authored changes.
